SELECT FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID finprodId,/* add by songyawei */ FINPROD_MARKET_ID code, FINPROD_ABBR shortName FROM FIN_PRODUCT LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE.FINPROD_ID
(FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat(concat('%', #{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR FINPROD_ABBR like concat(concat('%', #{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%'))
AND FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE.TYPE_8 IS NOT NULL AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F01','F06','F10')

SELECT FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID finprodId,/* add by songyawei */ FINPROD_MARKET_ID code, FINPROD_ABBR shortName FROM FIN_PRODUCT LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE.FINPROD_ID
(FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat(concat('%', #{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR FINPROD_ABBR like concat(concat('%', #{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%'))
AND FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE.TYPE_8 IS NOT NULL AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 not in ('F01','F06','F10')
UNION ALL SELECT '' finprodId,/* add by songyawei */ TARGET_ID code, TARGET_NAME shortName FROM OPT_TARGET_INFO
(TARGET_ID like concat(concat('%', #{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR TARGET_NAME like concat(concat('%', #{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%'))
SELECT T1.REAL_NAME realName, T1.USER_NAME userName FROM SYS_USER T1 where T1.USER_NAME = #{userName}

SELECT SUM(T1.BID_PRIN_AMT) bidPrinAmt, LISTAGG(T1.BID_PRICE * 100 ||'%',',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY T1.BID_PRICE) bidPrice, T3.IS_WIN isWin, SUM(T2.WIN_PRIN_AMT) winPrinAmt, T3.BID_ID bidId FROM ETR_ENTRUST_BID_PRICE T1 LEFT JOIN BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE T2 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID=T2.ENTRUST_ID and T1.BID_PRICE = T2.BID_PRICE LEFT JOIN BID_ORDER T3 ON T2.BID_ID=T3.BID_ID WHERE T1.ENTRUST_ID=#{entrustId} GROUP BY (T3.IS_WIN, T3.BID_ID)
